meta.description: Primary Sjögren's syndrome keyword clusters, full systemic scope. Spans sicca-complex management (secretagogues, ocular surface care), HCQ + off-label immunosuppression, the active Ph3 / Ph2 pipeline (ianalumab, dazodalibep, nipocalimab, tibulizumab, iscalimab), extraglandular involvement (ILD, peripheral / small-fiber / autonomic neuropathy, RTA, cryoglobulinemia, vasculitis, MALT lymphoma risk), and the diagnostic workup anchored on anti-Ro/SSA + anti-La/SSB serology and lip biopsy focus score. Parent_theme / parent_subtheme reference codebook.json @ 2.0.

clusters.label: Hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil)
clusters.description: Antimalarial used as background therapy for fatigue, arthralgia, and mild systemic involvement in primary Sjögren's — modest evidence but widely prescribed.

clusters.label: Pilocarpine (Salagen)
clusters.description: Oral muscarinic agonist secretagogue for dry mouth — stimulates residual salivary and lacrimal gland function.

clusters.label: Cevimeline (Evoxac)
clusters.description: Oral M3-selective muscarinic agonist secretagogue — second oral option alongside pilocarpine.

clusters.label: Cyclosporine eye drops (Restasis / Cequa)
clusters.description: Topical cyclosporine for chronic dry eye in Sjögren's — Restasis 0.05% and Cequa 0.09%.

clusters.label: Lifitegrast (Xiidra)
clusters.description: LFA-1 antagonist eye drop for chronic dry eye disease.

clusters.label: Varenicline nasal spray (Tyrvaya)
clusters.description: Nasal-spray nicotinic agonist stimulating trigeminal parasympathetic outflow to the lacrimal glands — approved for dry-eye signs / symptoms.

clusters.label: Artificial tears / lubricating drops
clusters.description: Preservative-free artificial tears, gels, and ointments — the daily floor of ocular-surface management.

clusters.label: Saliva substitutes / xylitol products
clusters.description: Artificial saliva, oral gels, lozenges, xylitol sprays / lozenges, Xylimelts — daily symptomatic relief for xerostomia.

clusters.label: Punctal plugs / occlusion
clusters.description: Silicone or dissolvable plugs in lacrimal puncta to retain tears — common second-line ophthalmology procedure.

clusters.label: Autologous serum eye drops
clusters.description: Custom serum-based eye drops compounded from the patient's blood — used for severe refractory keratoconjunctivitis sicca.

clusters.label: Scleral lenses / PROSE
clusters.description: Specialty scleral contact lenses (PROSE devices) creating a saline reservoir over the cornea — used for severe ocular Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Corticosteroids (systemic)
clusters.description: Oral prednisone or IV methylprednisolone for systemic flares, ILD, vasculitis, or neurological involvement — short-term bridges rather than maintenance.

clusters.label: Methotrexate
clusters.description: Methotrexate used off-label for arthralgia and inflammatory arthritis in Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Mycophenolate (off-label)
clusters.description: Mycophenolate used off-label for ILD, CNS involvement, or steroid-sparing in systemic Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Azathioprine (off-label)
clusters.description: Azathioprine used off-label as a steroid-sparing immunosuppressant.

clusters.label: Rituximab (off-label)
clusters.description: Anti-CD20 B-cell depletion used off-label for severe extraglandular Sjögren's — cryoglobulinemia, vasculitis, neurological involvement.

clusters.label: Cyclophosphamide (rescue)
clusters.description: Cyclophosphamide reserved for severe vasculitis, CNS disease, or rapidly progressive ILD.

clusters.label: IVIG (severe extraglandular)
clusters.description: Intravenous immunoglobulin for severe neuropathy or refractory extraglandular Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Low-dose naltrexone (LDN)
clusters.description: Low-dose naltrexone — off-label adjunct popular in patient communities for fatigue / pain in Sjögren's; limited trial evidence.

clusters.label: Ianalumab (anti-BAFF-R, Ph3)
clusters.description: Anti-BAFF receptor monoclonal antibody depleting B cells via BAFF-R. Phase 3 NEPTUNUS for primary Sjögren's. Novartis.

clusters.label: Dazodalibep (anti-CD40L, Ph2/3)
clusters.description: Anti-CD40 ligand fusion protein blocking T-cell co-stimulation. Late-Ph2 / Ph3 for primary Sjögren's. Amgen (Horizon-acquired).

clusters.label: Nipocalimab (anti-FcRn, Ph2)
clusters.description: Anti-FcRn monoclonal accelerating IgG clearance, including pathogenic autoantibodies. Phase 2 DAHLIAS for Sjögren's. Johnson & Johnson.

clusters.label: Tibulizumab (IL-17/BAFF, Ph2)
clusters.description: Bispecific antibody targeting IL-17A and BAFF. Phase 2 for primary Sjögren's. Eli Lilly.

clusters.label: Iscalimab (anti-CD40, Ph2)
clusters.description: Anti-CD40 monoclonal antibody blocking germinal-center co-stimulation. Phase 2 in primary Sjögren's. Novartis.

clusters.label: RSLV-132 (Fc-RNase, Ph2)
clusters.description: Fc-RNase fusion targeting circulating immunostimulatory RNA. Phase 2 for fatigue endpoint in Sjögren's. Resolve Therapeutics.

clusters.label: Telitacicept (BLyS/APRIL, Ph2)
clusters.description: BLyS/APRIL fusion explored in Sjögren's; further along in IgAN and SLE. RemeGen.

clusters.label: Abatacept (off-label, mixed evidence)
clusters.description: CTLA-4-Ig fusion blocking T-cell co-stimulation; ASAP-III trial in pSS missed primary endpoint but is used off-label in some practices.

clusters.label: Belimumab (off-label)
clusters.description: Anti-BLyS / BAFF monoclonal — sometimes tried off-label in Sjögren's overlap with SLE.

clusters.label: Dry mouth / xerostomia
clusters.description: The cardinal oral symptom — sticky mouth, thick saliva, food sticking to roof of mouth, water at the bedside, sipping all day.

clusters.label: Dry eyes / keratoconjunctivitis sicca
clusters.description: Burning, gritty, foreign-body sensation; blurred vision late in the day; need for tears every hour.

clusters.label: Fatigue (defining symptom)
clusters.description: Disabling fatigue — frequently rated by patients as more disruptive than sicca. Not proportional to disease activity by standard measures.

clusters.label: Arthralgia / inflammatory arthritis
clusters.description: Joint pain — predominantly hands, wrists, knees — sometimes inflammatory, sometimes overlap with RA.

clusters.label: Parotid / salivary gland swelling
clusters.description: Recurrent salivary gland enlargement — parotid or submandibular. Persistent unilateral swelling warrants lymphoma workup.

clusters.label: Dental decay / cavities
clusters.description: Accelerated dental caries from reduced salivary protection — root caries, cracking teeth, frequent fillings, crowns, extractions.

clusters.label: Burning mouth / tongue
clusters.description: Burning tongue or mouth — chronic and miserable, sometimes persists for months / years.

clusters.label: Taste loss / dysgeusia
clusters.description: Loss of taste or distorted taste — food tasting different, metallic taste, less interest in eating.

clusters.label: Dysphagia / swallowing difficulty
clusters.description: Trouble swallowing dry foods — bread, pills, dry meat — sometimes choking sensation.

clusters.label: Dry nose / throat / sinuses
clusters.description: Nasal crusting, nosebleeds, dry throat, hoarseness, post-nasal drip — often missed as part of Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Chronic dry cough
clusters.description: Persistent dry cough from airway dryness or early interstitial lung involvement.

clusters.label: Vaginal dryness / dyspareunia
clusters.description: Vaginal dryness and painful intercourse — common and under-discussed sicca manifestation.

clusters.label: Dry / itchy skin
clusters.description: Dry, itchy skin; sometimes annular erythema; cutaneous involvement in primary Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Interstitial lung disease (ILD)
clusters.description: Sjögren's-associated ILD — most often NSIP, sometimes LIP. Cough, dyspnea, HRCT findings.

clusters.label: Peripheral neuropathy
clusters.description: Sensory or sensorimotor neuropathy — numbness, tingling, burning, in stocking-glove distribution.

clusters.label: Small-fiber neuropathy
clusters.description: Painful small-fiber neuropathy — burning, autonomic features, sometimes confirmed on skin biopsy intraepidermal nerve fiber density.

clusters.label: Autonomic dysfunction / POTS
clusters.description: Postural tachycardia, orthostatic intolerance, GI dysmotility, sweating changes — autonomic component of Sjögren's.

clusters.label: Raynaud's phenomenon
clusters.description: Color change and numbness of fingers / toes with cold or stress — common Sjögren's feature.

clusters.label: Renal tubular acidosis (RTA)
clusters.description: Distal renal tubular acidosis from tubulointerstitial nephritis — hypokalemia, kidney stones, sometimes hypokalemic periodic paralysis.

clusters.label: Cryoglobulinemia
clusters.description: Cryoglobulin-driven vasculitis — palpable purpura, peripheral neuropathy, glomerulonephritis. A red flag for lymphoma risk.

clusters.label: Sjögren's vasculitis
clusters.description: Cutaneous or systemic vasculitis — palpable purpura, urticarial vasculitis, sometimes mononeuritis multiplex.

clusters.label: Lymphoma risk (MALT)
clusters.description: 5-10% lifetime risk of B-cell lymphoma — most often MALT lymphoma of parotid. Persistent gland swelling, low C4, cryoglobulins, palpable purpura, lymphadenopathy are risk markers.

clusters.label: Hashimoto's / autoimmune thyroid
clusters.description: Autoimmune thyroid disease — Hashimoto's hypothyroidism most often — frequent comorbidity.

clusters.label: Fibromyalgia overlap
clusters.description: Fibromyalgia-like widespread pain frequently coexists; complicates the fatigue / pain attribution conversation.

clusters.label: Anti-Ro / SSA
clusters.description: Anti-Ro / SSA autoantibody — present in ~70% of pSS; central diagnostic and classification criterion.

clusters.label: Anti-La / SSB
clusters.description: Anti-La / SSB autoantibody — present in ~40%; helpful but no longer required in 2016 ACR/EULAR classification.

clusters.label: ANA / rheumatoid factor
clusters.description: Antinuclear antibody and rheumatoid factor — typically positive in pSS; sometimes the entry into the workup.

clusters.label: Lip biopsy / focus score
clusters.description: Minor salivary gland biopsy with focus score ≥ 1 — one of the two key 2016 ACR/EULAR classification anchors.

clusters.label: Schirmer test / ocular staining
clusters.description: Schirmer strip (< 5 mm / 5 min) and ocular surface staining (OSS / van Bijsterveld) — objective dry-eye measures in classification.

clusters.label: Salivary flow / sialometry
clusters.description: Unstimulated whole salivary flow rate (< 0.1 mL/min) — objective oral dryness measure.

clusters.label: ESSDAI / ESSPRI
clusters.description: EULAR Sjögren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index (physician) and Patient-Reported Index (patient) — the trial outcome instruments.

clusters.label: Salivary ultrasound / MRI
clusters.description: Salivary ultrasound or MR sialography — increasingly used as non-invasive adjunct to biopsy.

clusters.label: Diagnostic delay (5-7 years)
clusters.description: Average 4-7 years to diagnosis — symptoms dismissed, misattributed to aging, allergies, dehydration, menopause, or anxiety.

clusters.label: Post-viral onset
clusters.description: Symptom onset described as following a viral illness — COVID, EBV, mono, prolonged URI.

clusters.label: Sicca relief on treatment
clusters.description: Felt improvement in dryness, eating dryness, eye comfort — usually on combinations of secretagogues + drops + saliva substitutes.

clusters.label: Fatigue improvement on treatment
clusters.description: Improvement in fatigue — the patient-priority outcome — on HCQ, LDN, or trial biologics; harder to achieve than sicca relief.

clusters.label: Plaquenil eye screening / retinopathy
clusters.description: Annual ophthalmology screening for HCQ retinopathy — anxiety about long-term Plaquenil use.

clusters.label: Immunosuppression / infections
clusters.description: Frequent or serious infections on systemic immunosuppression — shingles, pneumonia, opportunistic.

clusters.label: Few approved therapies
clusters.description: Frustration that no disease-modifying therapy is yet approved for systemic Sjögren's — most treatment is off-label, borrowed from SLE / RA playbooks.

clusters.label: Rheumatology access / wait times
clusters.description: Long waits for rheumatology, dismissal by general practice, and the burden of advocating for the Sjögren's workup.

clusters.label: Dental cost burden
clusters.description: Out-of-pocket dental costs from accelerated caries — crowns, root canals, extractions, implants, dentures — uncovered by most medical insurance.

clusters.label: Lymphoma anxiety
clusters.description: Living with the elevated lifetime lymphoma risk — every persistent gland swelling, every lump, every CBC checked.

clusters.label: Invisible illness (Sjögren's)
clusters.description: Looking healthy with disabling symptoms — fatigue, dryness, pain — that family, friends, and employers minimize.

clusters.label: Work / school disruption
clusters.description: Impact of fatigue, brain fog, dental work, eye symptoms on employment — including reduced hours, FMLA, disability claims.

clusters.label: Dental appearance / self-consciousness
clusters.description: Self-consciousness about tooth loss, broken teeth, parotid swelling, or speech-impacted dryness.

clusters.label: Sjögren's Foundation
clusters.description: Sjögren's Foundation (US) — patient advocacy, clinical practice guidelines, awareness campaigns, patient education materials.

clusters.label: Sjögren's online community
clusters.description: Facebook Sjögren's groups, Reddit r/Sjogrens, online patient forums — peer support and management hacks.

clusters.label: Oral care regimen (fluoride trays / xylitol)
clusters.description: Daily oral care — fluoride trays, prescription toothpaste, xylitol, frequent dental visits — preserving teeth.

clusters.label: Humidifier / environmental control
clusters.description: Bedroom humidifier, avoiding ceiling fans / dry-air HVAC, wraparound sunglasses, moisture-chamber eyewear.

clusters.label: Rheum / ophthalmology / dental coordination
clusters.description: Coordinating care across rheumatology, ophthalmology, dental, and (when systemic) pulmonology / neurology.

clusters.label: Trial endpoints (ESSDAI / ESSPRI)
clusters.description: ESSDAI and ESSPRI as the dominant primary and secondary endpoints in Sjögren's trials — and the patient-experience gap they have struggled to capture (fatigue, brain fog).

clusters.label: Pipeline awareness
clusters.description: Patient awareness of the active pipeline — ianalumab, dazodalibep, nipocalimab, iscalimab, tibulizumab — and the hope of a first disease-modifying approval.

clusters.label: Trial eligibility (ESSDAI ≥ / seropositive)
clusters.description: Most pSS trials require objective disease activity (ESSDAI threshold) and seropositivity (anti-Ro/SSA) — seronegative patients often screen out.
